module-0-student-roster-project.label: Module 0 First-Week Roster Check
module-0-student-roster-project.summary: Build a small student-roster query, verify its returned columns, then extend the same working query with one additional roster field.

mp-1-preview-student-roster.title: Preview the roster columns
mp-1-preview-student-roster.prompt: Start the student roster by returning `id`, `name`, and `grade` from the `students` table.
mp-1-preview-student-roster.hint: Keep the existing roster query and add the one missing requested field.

help.concept: This first milestone creates the working roster query that the next milestone will extend.
help.hint_1: The final result needs `id`, `name`, and `grade`, in that order.
help.hint_2: Run the query and confirm the result has three columns in the requested order.

mp-1-preview-student-roster.starterCode:
-- Return id, name, and grade from students.
SELECT
  id,
  name
FROM students;
mp-1-preview-student-roster.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  grade
FROM students;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `students` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `id`, `name`, `grade`.

mp-2-add-city-to-roster.title: Add each student's city
mp-2-add-city-to-roster.prompt: Keep the working roster and return `id`, `name`, `grade`, and `city`, in that order.
mp-2-add-city-to-roster.hint: Extend the approved result with the new roster field instead of starting over.

help.concept: A cumulative project keeps approved work intact and adds only the new stakeholder requirement.
help.hint_1: Preserve the three fields from the previous milestone.
help.hint_2: The completed result should have four columns in the requested order.

mp-2-add-city-to-roster.starterCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  grade
FROM students;
mp-2-add-city-to-roster.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  grade,
  city
FROM students;

sketch_project_brief.title: The roster import needs a quick verification.
sketch_project_brief.bodyMarkdown:
The school office has imported its student roster and needs a quick verification before staff use it.

Start with a small roster result containing the requested student fields. Run it and inspect the returned column headers and rows. Then extend that exact working query with the student's city.

This project is still about the basic workflow: **edit → run → inspect → extend → rerun**. The next module explains SELECT lists and column choices in detail.
